items.caption: About MTN2...
items.hint: Shows the version, the renderer in use and the project links.

items.caption: Check for updates...
items.hint: Checks for a new version and offers to download it. Nothing is downloaded without consent.

items.caption: Find command...
items.hint: Searches all menu commands by name, category or key, and runs the chosen one.

items.caption: Help contents
items.hint: Opens the help window with the contents.

items.caption: Quit
items.hint: Closes the program and saves settings, panels and tabs.

items.caption: Drive selection...
items.hint: Lists the drives, network resources and special folders for the left panel.

items.caption: Sort menu...
items.hint: Chooses the sort order of the left panel: by name, extension, size or date.

items.caption: Column modes...
items.hint: Switches the left panel between column layouts: brief, full or custom.

items.caption: Info panel toggle
items.hint: Turns the info panel (drive, memory) on or off on the side next to the left panel.

items.caption: Show hidden/system files
items.hint: Shows or hides hidden and system files in the left panel.

items.caption: New panel tab
items.hint: Opens a new tab in the left panel with the current folder.

items.caption: Close panel tab
items.hint: Closes the current tab of the left panel.

items.caption: Toggle Left panel
items.hint: Hides or shows the left panel.

items.caption: View
items.hint: Opens the file under the cursor in the viewer.

items.caption: Edit
items.hint: Opens the file under the cursor in the editor.

items.caption: View externally
items.hint: Opens the file under the cursor in the external viewer set in the options.

items.caption: Edit externally
items.hint: Opens the file under the cursor in the external editor set in the options.

items.caption: Quick View...
items.hint: Shows the file under the cursor on the other panel: a picture, text, Markdown or a hex dump.

items.caption: New file
items.hint: Creates a new file in the current folder and opens it in the editor.

items.caption: Copy
items.hint: Copies the selected items to the folder of the other panel.

items.caption: Move
items.hint: Moves the selected items to the folder of the other panel.

items.caption: Rename
items.hint: Renames the item under the cursor.

items.caption: Make directory
items.hint: Creates a new folder in the current folder.
items.aliases: new folder, create directory, mkdir, folder

items.caption: Create link...
items.hint: Creates a symbolic link, hard link or junction.

items.caption: Set attributes...
items.hint: Edits attributes, owner and dates of the selected items.

items.caption: Properties...
items.hint: Opens the Windows Properties window for the selection or the item under the cursor.

items.caption: Windows context menu
items.hint: Opens the Windows context menu, as a right click does in Explorer.

items.caption: Compare files...
items.hint: Compares the files under the cursors of both panels.

items.caption: Checksums...
items.hint: Calculates MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 of the selected files; on a checksum file it verifies it.

items.caption: Multi-rename...
items.hint: Renames the selected items in one go: masks, counter, search and replace, letter case.

items.caption: Restore from Recycle Bin
items.hint: Returns the item selected in the Recycle Bin to its original place.

items.caption: Delete
items.hint: Deletes the selected items; in the Recycle Bin view it removes them for good.

items.caption: Delete cursor item
items.hint: Deletes permanently, bypassing the Recycle Bin.

items.caption: Pack archive
items.hint: Packs the selected items into an archive.

items.caption: Unpack archive
items.hint: Unpacks the archive under the cursor to a folder.

items.caption: Select by mask...
items.hint: Selects the files whose names match a mask, for example *.txt.

items.caption: Unselect by mask...
items.hint: Clears the selection of the files whose names match a mask.

items.caption: Select by extension
items.hint: Selects all the files with the same extension as the one under the cursor.

items.caption: Unselect by extension
items.hint: Clears the selection of all the files with the same extension as the one under the cursor.

items.caption: Select all
items.hint: Selects every file in the panel.

items.caption: Unselect all
items.hint: Clears the selection in the panel.

items.caption: Invert selection
items.hint: Selects the files that are not selected and clears the selected ones.

items.caption: Restore selection
items.hint: Brings back the selection that was before the last reset, for example after a copy; pressed again it goes back.

items.caption: Calculate folder size
items.hint: Counts the size of the folder under the cursor with all its content.
items.aliases: size, folder size, du, disk usage

items.caption: Copy full path
items.hint: Copies the full path of the selected items to the clipboard.

items.caption: Copy name
items.hint: Copies only the name of the selected items to the clipboard.

items.caption: Export list...
items.hint: Saves the selected items to a text, Markdown or CSV file with the chosen fields.
items.aliases: export, save list, file list, csv, markdown

items.caption: Describe...
items.hint: Stores a description of the file in Descript.ion next to it.

items.caption: Run detached (OS)
items.hint: Starts the file or the command in a separate OS window, independent of the program.
items.aliases: run, launch, start, open with system

items.caption: Run in background
items.hint: Starts the console program under the cursor in the background console, which shows the start for a moment.

items.caption: Run in new tab
items.hint: Starts the console program under the cursor in a terminal tab of its own.

items.caption: Copy
items.hint: Copies the selected text to the clipboard.

items.caption: Cut
items.hint: Cuts the selected text to the clipboard.

items.caption: Paste
items.hint: Inserts the text from the clipboard.

items.caption: Goto line...
items.hint: Moves the cursor to the line with the number you enter.

items.caption: Find...
items.hint: Searches for text in the open document.

items.caption: Find and replace...
items.hint: Searches for text in the editor and replaces it with another.

items.caption: Encoding...
items.hint: Chooses the encoding the file is shown and saved in.

items.caption: Undo
items.hint: Takes back the last change in the editor.

items.caption: Redo
items.hint: Returns the change that was taken back.

items.caption: Hex↔Text
items.hint: Switches the viewer between the text and the hex dump of the file.

items.caption: Sort lines ascending
items.hint: Sorts the selected lines from A to Z.

items.caption: Sort lines descending
items.hint: Sorts the selected lines from Z to A.

items.caption: Remove repeated lines
items.hint: Removes the repeated lines from the selection and keeps the first of each.

items.caption: Format text to width...
items.hint: Rewraps the selected text to the width you enter.

items.caption: Shift lines right
items.hint: Moves the selected lines right by one indent.

items.caption: Shift lines left
items.hint: Moves the selected lines left by one indent.

items.caption: Toggle bookmark
items.hint: Sets or removes a bookmark on the current line.

items.caption: Next bookmark
items.hint: Jumps to the next bookmark.

items.caption: Previous bookmark
items.hint: Jumps to the previous bookmark.

items.caption: Bookmark list...
items.hint: Lists the bookmarks of the document; Enter jumps to the chosen one.

items.caption: Auto-indent mode
items.hint: Turns on or off carrying the indent of a line to the new line on Enter.

items.caption: Find file...
items.hint: Searches for files by name, and by text inside them if you ask.

items.caption: Synchronize dirs...
items.hint: Synchronizes the folders of the two panels, one-way or two-way. The dry-run check box shows the plan without changing anything.

items.caption: Compare folders
items.hint: Selects the files of both panels that are missing on the other side or newer than their namesakes.

items.caption: User menu
items.hint: Opens the user menu with your own commands.

items.caption: History back
items.hint: Returns the panel to the previous folder.

items.caption: History forward
items.hint: Moves the panel to the next folder of its history.

items.caption: Folder history...
items.hint: Lists the folders visited before; Enter opens the chosen one.

items.caption: File history...
items.hint: Lists the files opened before; Enter opens the chosen one.

items.caption: Directory hotlist...
items.hint: Lists your favorite folders for a quick jump.

items.caption: Add to hotlist
items.hint: Adds the current folder to the favorites.

items.caption: Workspaces...
items.hint: Lists the saved workspaces to open, rename or delete.

items.caption: Save workspace
items.hint: Saves the current workspace: its panels and tabs.

items.caption: SSH/SFTP Connections...
items.hint: Lists the saved SSH and SFTP connections; F7 adds one, Enter opens it.

items.caption: File associations...
items.hint: Sets which program opens which files on Enter.

items.caption: Flat/branch view
items.hint: Shows all the files of the folder and its subfolders in one list, or goes back.

items.caption: Panel filter...
items.hint: Hides the files that do not match the text you type.

items.caption: Hide / show passive panel
items.hint: Hides or shows the panel that is not active.

items.caption: Recycle bin
items.hint: Opens the Recycle Bin in the active panel.

items.caption: Command history...
items.hint: Lists the commands typed before; Enter puts the chosen one on the command line without running it.

items.caption: Drive root
items.hint: Goes to the root folder of the current drive.

items.caption: Refresh panel
items.hint: Reads the current folder again.

items.caption: Swap panels
items.hint: Swaps the left and right panels.

items.caption: Target := Active
items.hint: Opens the folder of the active panel in the other panel.

items.caption: Active := Target
items.hint: Opens the folder of the other panel in the active panel.

items.caption: Insert item name
items.hint: Puts the name of the item under the cursor on the command line.

items.caption: Insert item path
items.hint: Puts the full path of the item under the cursor on the command line.

items.caption: Focus command line
items.hint: Moves the focus to the command line.

items.caption: Console toggle
items.hint: Shows the console over the panels, or returns to the panels.

items.caption: Background console...
items.hint: Chooses the shell (cmd, PowerShell, bash...) that the console and launched programs use.
items.aliases: shell, terminal, console, bash, powershell, pwsh, cmd, profile

items.caption: Sync console dir
items.hint: Sends cd to the console so it works in the active panel's folder. No files are changed.

items.caption: Save console output...
items.hint: Writes the console scrollback to a UTF-8 text file.

items.caption: Clear console buffer
items.hint: Erases the console buffer; the shell keeps running.

items.caption: New terminal...
items.hint: Opens a new workspace tab with a shell (cmd, PowerShell, WSL...).

items.caption: Next tab
items.hint: Switches to the next workspace tab.

items.caption: Reload keymap
items.hint: Reads keymap.json again, so changes apply without a restart.

items.caption: Plugins...
items.hint: Lists the installed plugins; Space turns one on or off.

items.caption: Color coding...
items.hint: Sets the colors of the file rows by name masks.

items.caption: Keymap...
items.hint: Lists the commands with their keys and lets you change them.

items.caption: Theme...
items.hint: Chooses or edits the color theme.
items.aliases: theme, colors, skin, dark, light, scheme

items.caption: Font / Display...
items.hint: Sets the font, its size, the cursor and the look of the selected files.
items.aliases: font, size, scale, zoom, display, screen, cursor

items.caption: User interface...
items.hint: Sets the interface language, notifications, the top lines of the window and drag and drop.
items.aliases: interface, language, menu bar, status line, notifications, editor, drag

items.caption: External viewer/editor...
items.hint: Sets the programs that Alt+F3 and Alt+F4 start.

items.caption: Terminal mouse on/off
items.hint: Text terminal version: turns the mouse off so that the terminal itself selects and copies text; run it again to turn the mouse back on.
items.aliases: mouse, select, copy, terminal, tmux, putty, ssh

items.caption: Console...
items.hint: Sets the size of the console history, paste confirmation and returning to the panels after a command.

items.caption: Environment profiles...
items.hint: Opens environment.json, the profiles of environment variables for the shells.
items.aliases: environment, variables, env, proxy, path, profile

items.caption: Markdown colors...
items.hint: Sets the colors used to show Markdown.

items.caption: Columns...
items.hint: Sets which columns the panels show and in what order.

items.caption: Zoom In
items.hint: Makes the font bigger.

items.caption: Zoom Out
items.hint: Makes the font smaller.

items.caption: Reset Zoom
items.hint: Returns the font to its normal size.

items.caption: Restore hidden dialogs
items.hint: Brings back the confirmations that were turned off with Do not ask again.
items.aliases: dialogs, hidden, confirmations, do not show again, restore

items.caption: Save settings
items.hint: Writes the current settings, panels and tabs to the settings file now instead of at exit.

items.caption: Export settings...
items.hint: Saves the settings to a file, to move them to another computer.

items.caption: Import settings...
items.hint: Loads the settings from a file saved earlier.

items.caption: Settings location...
items.hint: Shows where the settings are kept and switches between the user folder and the portable mode.

items.caption: Drive selection...
items.hint: Lists the drives, network resources and special folders for the right panel.

items.caption: Sort menu...
items.hint: Chooses the sort order of the right panel: by name, extension, size or date.

items.caption: Column modes...
items.hint: Switches the right panel between column layouts: brief, full or custom.

items.caption: Info panel toggle
items.hint: Turns the info panel (drive, memory) on or off on the side next to the right panel.

items.caption: Show hidden/system files
items.hint: Shows or hides hidden and system files in the right panel.

items.caption: New panel tab
items.hint: Opens a new tab in the right panel with the current folder.

items.caption: Close panel tab
items.hint: Closes the current tab of the right panel.

items.caption: Toggle Right panel
items.hint: Hides or shows the right panel.
